                <h1 class="hotel-landing__name">Pousada Vila Guará</h1>

                <div class="hotel-landing__address">
                    <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/location_map_icon.svg" alt="location">
                    <span>RUA BEIRA MAR SN , Barreirinhas 65590000</span>
                    <a class="hotel-landing__map-link location_maps" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#hotel_map">
                        See on Map                    </a>
                </div>

                <div class="hotel-landing__description">
                    Your unforgettable experience in Atins begins at Vila Guará!
Facing the beach, our guesthouse combines rustic charm with comfort and a welcoming atmosphere. Here you'll find everything you need to relax and connect with nature: a spacious garden, a bar and restaurant serving creative regional cuisine, a spa with invigorating massages, and even a fully equipped kitesurfing school—perfect for those who want to learn or already practice the sport.

Cozy and sustainable chalets
Designed to take advantage of natural ventilation, our chalets do not have air conditioning, but they do have fans and mosquito nets on all beds. Each one features a private balcony, minibar, wardrobe, bathroom with hot shower, free amenities, and Wi-Fi.

All accommodations include a delicious full breakfast to help you start the day with energy.

Private location: beachfront and with easy access to Lençóis Maranhenses National Park.

The nearest airport is in São Luís, Maranhão.

If you're looking for tranquility, nature, and a touch of adventure, Vila Guará is the ideal place for your stay in Atins!
                </div>
            </div>

    <script>
        (function () {
            // Collapse/expand the hotel detail block via the chevron on the hotel name
            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                // Ignore clicks inside the TripAdvisor widget — those should open the reviews
                // popup, not toggle the mobile-header collapse.
                if (e.target.closest('.hotel-landing__tripadvisor')) return;
                var toggle = e.target.closest('.hotel-landing__name-toggle');
                if (!toggle) return;
                toggle.classList.toggle('open');
                var block = document.querySelector('.hotel-landing__collapsible');
                if (block) block.classList.toggle('open');
            });

            // "Sobre o Hotel" accordion (the description block has no handler in main.js)
            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var title = e.target.closest('.mobile_hotel_description_title');
                if (!title) return;
                title.classList.toggle('open-bg-image');
                var body = title.parentElement.querySelector('.mobile_hotel_description_long');
                if (body) body.classList.toggle('show');
            });

            // Sticky search bar — detect the real "stuck" state via a sentinel just above the
            // holder. main_v4.js sets full-width padding inline based on a hardcoded scroll
            // threshold (440px) which is wrong on the LP; this observer toggles a class only
            // when the bar is actually pinned to the top.
            var sentinel = document.querySelector('.lp-search-bar-sentinel');
            var holder = document.querySelector('.mobile_hotel_search_bar_holder');
            if (sentinel && holder && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
                new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
                    holder.classList.toggle('is-stuck', !entries[0].isIntersecting);
                }, { threshold: 0 }).observe(sentinel);
            }
        })();
    </script>

<script>
if (typeof $ !== 'undefined') {
    
    $.ajaxSetup({
        headers: {
        'X-CSRF-TOKEN': $('meta[name="csrf-token"]').attr('content')
        },error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
            if (jqXHR.status === 419) {
                if ($('#session_timeout').length>0) {
                    $('#session_timeout').modal('show');
                }else if($('#session-expired').length>0) {
                    $('#session-expired').modal('show'); 
                }
            }
            if (jqXHR.status === 500) {
                let url = new URL(window.location.href);
                let doReload = false;
                let pathname = this.url;
                if (
                    pathname.includes('step2save') ||
                    pathname.includes('step3save') ||
                    pathname.includes('step4save') ||
                    pathname.includes('step2payment')
                ) {
                    doReload = true;
                }
            
                if (doReload) {
                
                    var errredir = url.searchParams.get('errredir');
                    if (errredir !== null && !isNaN(errredir)) {
                        errredir = parseInt(errredir);
                        errredir += 1; 
                    } else {
                        errredir = 1;
                    }
                
                    url.searchParams.set("errredir", errredir);
                    window.location.href = url.toString();
                }
            }
        }
    });
}
